problem_statement: Compare the physical principles and practical trade-offs of adiabatic quantum computing versus gate-model quantum computing for combinatorial optimization problems. Discuss which algorithmic families are known to benefit, the role of error correction and noise, and the current experimental status as of 2025.

Analyze how central bank digital currency (CBDC) design choices affect financial stability and monetary policy transmission. Compare retail vs wholesale CBDC architectures, the implications of programmability and interest-bearing designs, and evidence from live pilots (e.g. China, Sweden, Nigeria) as of 2025.

Evaluate the state of the art in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for long-horizon multi-hop question answering. Compare dense retrieval, graph-based retrieval, and agentic retrieval strategies; identify the main failure modes (lost in the middle, citation grounding, context budget) and summarize 2024-2025 empirical results.
